entities.summary: The Kavkaz Center is a Finland/Sweden-based privately run website/portal which aims to be "a Chechen internet agency which is independent, international and Islamic". The stated mission of the site is to report events related to Chechnya and also to "provide international news agencies with news-letters, background information and assistance in making independent journalistic work in North Caucasus". The site has a ties to Islamic terrorist groups in Russia and acts as it's mouthpiece, numerously being used to claim responsibility for terror attacks, such as Moscow theater and Beslan school hostage crises.
